- **Create**: `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`, inside `CreateMemo` — called right after content-length validation, before `s.Store.CreateMemo(ctx, create)` persists the memo.

- `Property.HasCode bool` — true if any code block/fenced code block/code span node is present.

content.text:
h14.

**Computation site:** `RebuildMemoPayload()` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-86`, which calls `markdownService.ExtractAll()` (implemented in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:355-419`, using a single goldmark AST walk over the memo content).

**Triggers:**
- `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`, called unconditionally when a memo is created.
- `UpdateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`, called only when the update mask includes the `content` path (i.e., only when the memo's content itself changes, not on visibility/pin/state-only edits).
- Bulk/background rebuild — `Runner.RunOnce()` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:29-71` iterates all memos in batches and calls `RebuildMemoPayload` + `Store.UpdateMemo` for each, used to backfill/repair payloads for existing memos (e.g. after logic changes).

**Extracted properties** (written into `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`, a `storepb.MemoPayload_Property`, per `proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go:85-95`):
- `Tags` — all `#tag` occurrences in the content (deduplicated, case-preserved).
- `Property.Title` — text of the first H1 heading, if it's the first block-level node in the document (`extractHeadingText`, markdown.go:384-386).
- `Property.HasLink` — set if any Markdown link node is present.
- `Property.HasCode` — set if any code block, fenced code block, or code span is present.
- `Property.HasTaskList` — set if any task checkbox exists.
- `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` — set if any task checkbox is unchecked.

(Mentions are also extracted in the same pass into `ExtractedData.Mentions`, but that field is used separately for notifications, not stored as memo payload metadata — `RebuildMemoPayload` only copies `Tags` and `Property` onto the memo.)
